Name: Standard Farm Clear
Author: Duckexza
Description:
Removes small parts of the map, giving more space for crops or buildings.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip/extract the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8766][CP] Standard Clear Space[/url]﻿﻿ folder into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI to play!
[/list]
To uninstall and return to the base Standard Farm map, delete the [CP] Standard Clear Space folder.


[img]http://i.imgur.com/xEV4WhO.png[/img]

Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to choose Farm Standard(default), Farm Standard With Water, Farm With Water, Farm With Minimal Water or Farm Without Water.

or

Change the [i]config.json[/i] file to [b]Farm Standard[/b](default), [b]Farm Standard With Water[/b], [b]Farm With Water, Farm With Minimal Water[/b] or [b]Farm Without Water[/b].

Manifest.Name: Standard Clear Space
Manifest.Description: Removed parts of the map to make the map more free.
